title: The Books That Shaped Atheism Worldwide
tags: christopher hitchens god is not great
description:
Some books don’t just inform — they spark revolutions of thought. In this video, Pale Blue Thoughts explores the most influential international books on atheism that inspired millions to question blind faith and embrace reason.

We’ll cover:

Richard Dawkins’ “The God Delusion” — dismantling the argument for God.

Christopher Hitchens’ “God is Not Great” — exposing the dangers of religion.

James Randi’s “Flim-Flam” — revealing the tricks of psychics, faith-healers, and frauds.

Sam Harris’ “The End of Faith” — calling out religious extremism and irrational belief.

Join us for a deep dive into the words and ideas that shaped the modern atheist movement.
